answer.rationale: A 24-hour report is required only when an employee's in-patient hospitalization resulted from a work-related incident. The supplied facts establish a hospital admission after illness, but do not establish either work-relatedness or that the admission was in-patient hospitalization.
answer.missing_information_or_escalation_reason: Determine whether the illness resulted from a work-related incident and whether the employee was admitted for in-patient hospitalization. If both are true, report to OSHA within 24 hours after the hospitalization.
